conventions.Color: sRGB PNG RGBA, straight (not premultiplied) alpha; RGB under alpha<0.9 replaced by the nearest opaque colour (edge bleeding, no dark halo)
conventions.uv: rects: pixel x,y from top-left; uv = [u, v, w, h] with Unity bottom-left origin

build: python3 -P Source~/build_cutouts.py <download_root> <out_dir> (download_root holds sparse clones of the repos named in sources[].url)
